last_name: Last name, surname or family name
phone: The candidate's own phone or mobile number, without country code
phone_with_country_code: The candidate's phone number in international format with country code
phone_country_code: Phone country code or dialing code selector
full_address: Whole mailing address in one field
current_location: Where the candidate lives or is based now
preferred_location: Preferred office or desired work location
willing_to_relocate: Willing to relocate, yes or no
willing_to_work_onsite: Willing to work from the office or onsite, yes or no
employment_type: Type of employment wanted, such as full-time, part-time or contract
website_url: Personal website, portfolio or blog URL
school: University, college or school attended for the degree
degree: Degree type, such as Bachelor of Technology
major: Field of study, branch or major
education_level: Highest level of education or qualification
education_start_date: Start date or year of the degree, in an education section
graduation_date: End date of the degree, in an education section
graduation_year: Graduation, passing out or class year of the degree
gpa: GPA, CGPA or grade of the degree
tenth_percentage: Percentage or marks in 10th standard, SSC
twelfth_percentage: Percentage or marks in 12th standard, HSC
current_title: Current or most recent job title
years_genai: Years of experience with generative AI or LLMs
years_agentic: Years of experience with agentic frameworks such as LangGraph
years_rag: Years of experience with RAG or vector databases
years_kubernetes: Years of experience with Kubernetes or GKE
years_aws: Years of experience with AWS specifically
years_cloud: Years of experience with cloud platforms generally
skills: Technical skills or technologies, as a list
current_ctc: Current CTC, salary or annual compensation
offered_ctc: CTC of an offer the candidate currently holds
notice_period_days: Notice period length, as a number of days
immediate_joiner: Whether the candidate can join immediately, yes or no
offer_in_hand: Whether the candidate holds another job offer, yes or no
night_shift: Whether the candidate can work night shifts or US hours, yes or no
authorized_to_work: Yes or no: legally authorized to work in the job's country
requires_sponsorship: Yes or no: needs visa sponsorship now or in future
previously_applied: Whether the candidate applied to or worked at this company before
felony: Whether the candidate has been convicted of a felony or crime
non_compete: Whether the candidate is bound by a non-compete or non-solicit agreement
background_check: Whether the candidate can pass a background check
drug_test: Whether the candidate can pass a drug test
drivers_license: Whether the candidate holds a valid driver's license
over_18: Whether the candidate is 18 or older
earliest_start_date: When the candidate can start the job (not an education date)
how_did_you_hear: How the candidate heard about this job
referral_name: Name of an employee who referred the candidate
consent_yes: A consent, privacy or terms checkbox that must be accepted to apply
notifications_opt_in: An optional marketing or job alert opt-in
resume_upload: A file input for the resume or CV
free_text: An open question needing a written answer in the candidate's own words
leave_blank: A cover letter, or contact details of someone other than the candidate, such as a reference, manager or emergency contact
unknown: The field matches none of the other options
work_history: The full list of past jobs. Never the answer for a single form field
